Hi Alice 20	3 great to meet you and thanks for the usage snapshot. Attaching a quick pricing workbook (redwood_pricing_workbook.xlsx) that lays out simple scenarios. Highlights here so you can digest fast:

- Hosted API (per-token): Best for fast integration and unpredictable workloads. Example: at your forecasted 6-month token volume (~1.2B input+output tokens), ballpark cost ~ $X/month (line items in workbook) 20	4 no commit required.

- Dedicated (reserved capacity): Good if you want predictable throughput and lower unit cost on sustained load. Typical structure: monthly reserved commit + marginal overage. For your peak profile, a 3-GPU reserved pool maps to ~Y req/s and shows ~30-40% cost savings vs hosted per-token at steady state. Workbook includes a 6/12-month commit comparison.

- Private VPC/on-prem: Enterprise licensing and infra+support fees apply. Onboarding 6-10 weeks (depending on infra readiness). Unit economics depend heavily on self-hosted infra amortization; we included a simple capex/opex worksheet.

Next steps I recommend: (1) confirm target latency (p95) and model family (we demoed a 7B variant) so we can finalize numbers; (2) decide if you want a Dedicated POC (2 weeks) to validate throughput.

I attached the workbook and a concise cost model PDF for exec review. Happy to schedule a follow-up Friday.

Good questions 20	4 answering inline and added a short math example in the attached PDF (deployment_mode_cost_model.pdf). Quick answers: 

1) Dedicated commits: typical terms are 3/6/12 months. Overage rate = committed unit price + small premium; committed GPUs are tenant-isolated (no preemption). Bursting options available for short windows.

2) Hosted per-token: yes 20	4 our hosted pricing workbook models caching/continuous batching impacts. For chatty workloads with shared system prompts we typically see 152�80	35% token reduction from prefix/KV caching depending on session reuse; workbook has both raw and caching-adjusted scenarios.

3) Private VPC: we offer a managed option (Redwood manages control plane and updates) or a self-managed option (customer controls infra and patches). Managed includes security patching, telemetry, and regular compatibility updates.

Example (from PDF): 1k-token request
- Hosted per-token: $0.012/request (example rate)
- Dedicated (12-mo amortized): $0.007/request after commit for steady-state usage (assumes 3-GPU pool and your 12-month forecast)
- Private VPC: depends on infra amortization; sample shown at $0.009/request including support and infra ops (varies).

Next steps: 1) Marissa 20	4 can you confirm if we want to propose a 12-month Dedicated quote with a trial discount? 2) Alice/Bob 20	4 if you can confirm target p95 latency (e.g., <150ms), I can lock in a recommended instance size and finalize the spreadsheet.

Thanks 20	3 I can host a 30-min math walkthrough Thursday or Friday.
